entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that he's hopeful that Tate (shoulder) will return to action Week 11 versus the Cowboys, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

entries.summary: out

entries.name: CJ Donaldson
entries.summary: out

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Sunday that he's "not certain" if Montgomery (groin) will be able to play Thursday against Indianapolis, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN reports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (back) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jared Wiley
entries.summary: Wiley suffered a fractured ankle in the Chiefs' 35-13 victory over the Falcons on Sunday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Jauan Jennings
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jaydn Ott
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison will require surgery on his thumb and will miss a few weeks, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Monangai (toe/thumb) was spotted working out during Monday's unofficial practice and is eyeing a return to action Sunday against the Saints, Chris Emma of 104-3 The Score Chicago reports.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (back) won't travel to Baltimore with the Chargers for Monday's game against the Ravens and has been downgraded from questionable to out for Week 10 action.

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Nov. 29 against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Tyrell Shavers
entries.summary: The Bills did not activate Shavers (knee) from the reserve/PUP list, and he will not be available for Sunday's game against the Jets.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: The Chargers list Thompson (hamstring) as doubtful for Monday's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Drake Maye
entries.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he didn't have a definitive diagnosis for the injury Maye (ankle) sustained in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, but indicated that the quarterback will miss time," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.  "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye," Vrabel said.

entries.name: Woody Marks
entries.summary: Coach DeMeco Ryans acknowledged after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns that Marks (concussion) is unlikely to play in Thursday night's game against the Colts, ESPN.com's DJ Bien-Aime reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) was spotted walking around with a limp in the locker room following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Mayfield's availability for next Sunday's game against the Lions is in question due to an injury he sustained to his foot and ankle area during the Buccaneers' Week 9 loss to the Bears, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bowers (ankle) is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Seahawks, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "It's not as bad as we thought, but still a significant injury," Kubiak said.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Geno Smith
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Smith will get further imaging on his left ankle Monday, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Jeshaun Jones
entries.summary: Jones (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Packers.

entries.name: Luther Burden III
entries.summary: Burden (concussion) was spotted participating in the Bears' unofficial practice session Monday, AllCHGO.com reports.

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle) will undergo imaging Monday, Eric Allen of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
entries.summary: Robinson is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jaguars due to an ankle injury.

entries.name: Adam Randall
entries.summary: Randall (neck), who remains on IR, has been tagged as questionable to face the Chargers on Monday.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: When asked Wednesday whether Pierce (heel) has a chance to return from IR this season, Colts head coach Shane Steichen was noncommittal, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: According to Ian Rapoport of NFL Network and ESPN,  Adams (hamstring) is believed to be targeting a return to action Nov. 25 against the Packers.

entries.name: Dyami Brown
entries.summary: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Gardner Minshew II
entries.summary: Minshew suffered a torn UCL in his right throwing elbow last Sunday at Seattle and is slated to undergo season-ending surgery, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
entries.summary: Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that while the 21-day practice window for Croskey-Merritt (groin) hasn't been opened yet, he notes that the running back is "trending in the right direction," Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded from doubtful to out for Sunday's game against the Saints, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Josh Whyle
entries.summary: Green Bay placed Whyle (concussion) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (thumb) is "doing well" and is expected to be out for "6-to-10 weeks," per head coach Jesse Minter.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that it has yet to be determined whether Willis (abdomen) will need surgery to address his groin/core injury.David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Could Mike McCarthy said Monday that the Steelers are 'hopeful' they can get Pittman -- who last played in Week 4 -- back from his foot injury this week, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: Mo Alie-Cox
entries.summary: The Colts placed Alie-Cox (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (knee/toe) has an expected return date of "mid-December," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Roman Wilson
entries.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said that he's "hopeful" Wilson (finger) will be able to return from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Henderson (illness) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tyler Goodson
entries.summary: The Cowboys placed Goodson (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Tommy Yarrish of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: The Eagles opened Shipley's (foot) 21-day practice window Monday.

entries.name: Zavier Scott
entries.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.
